title: Filing complaints with the State Commission
description: Filing complaints with the State Commission where the value of goods or services exceeds rupees one crore but does not exceed rupees ten crore

steps.step: Complaint filing with the State Commission for goods or services valued between one crore and ten crore rupees

complaints against unfair contracts, where the value of goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed ten crore rupees

records and orders in any consumer dispute pending before or decided by any District Commission within the State
